notes.title: Languages and operating systems problems
notes.content:
[h1]Languages and operating systems problems[/h1]

Bugfixing: 

Problems with the language and the compatibility with some operating systems

There are two known bugs that we are currently working on:

1) The download of the english version resulted in a german version.
2) The game didn`t function on Linux or Macintosh computers.

Something went wrong with the upload. We are very sorry for this incident and are currently working hard to fix the problems. In some hours they shall be solved. If this bugs occur in your version, please uninstall the game and install it again.

So long
the Game Alchemists
